parsed.reason: Real, age-grounded coaching for an 8-year-old. It says night waking is common at this age and why, then gives a concrete wind-down for tonight and a calm way to handle the 2am wake. The one-clause doctor mention sits on top of a real answer, so it is not a handback. There is no diagnosis or medicine, and the closing offer of the full plan is the product's own line. Blemish: at roughly 500 characters it runs well past the ~300 budget, and the night-waking and doctor clauses could have been tighter.
